text:
Riley C: CI red on feature/fast-batch — infra test `kv-cache-invalidation` failing on matrix linux-3. Anyone can trigger a lightweight retry? I don't want to rebuild images.
Maria K: You can use the 'rebuild-only' flag in the pipeline. For GH actions our helper is:
```
./tools/ci rerun --jobs=infra-tests --rebuild-only --no-image
```
Works for 95% of flakes.
Aj Patel: If you're on Circle we use `circleci-cli retry <build-num> --skip-build` — but ping CI Bot if you need perms.
Riley C: The build is 12345 on actions. Is there an equivalent for actions? Don't want full run.
Sam B: For actions use:
```
gh api repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/:run_id/rerun --field rebuild_only=true
```
(Not a public flag but our wrapper does it.)
Maria K: Also helpful to target the matrix axis:
```
./tools/ci rerun --job=infra-test --matrix=linux-3 --rebuild-only
```
Aj Patel: If it's clearly flaky, we can bisect with `--bisect` flag: will resubmit narrower commits.
Riley C: ok thanks, trying the tools/ci command now.
CI Bot: queued rebuild-only rerun for build 12345 (job infra-tests, axis linux-3) — triggered by Riley C
Sam B: If it hangs ping me and I'll escalate to infra to avoid image-build accidentally starting.
Maria K: FYI I'll add a quick note in the PR: 'skipped image rebuild — rerun infra-test only'.
Riley C: deployed, green on rerun :tada: thanks all
